ChangeTip is something that was used in a number of subs on that other site. Basically you setup/funded a ChangeTip account and it allowed you tip other users in lieu of gilding. The idea here is to kick out (or replace I suppose) the middleman and allow Voat to enable this directly. Users would have a tip balance that could be reloaded or withdrawn using bitcoin. Users could tip each other which would add some modest flair to the post. The site could fund itself using this method by, for instance, charging a fee of 10% on any deposit or withdrawal of the currency. So ultimately 20% of all deposits would go to Voat. If it became popular this could be a way to easily fund the site in a way that would scale as the site grew and also encourage and reward quality contributions.
